observabilityAgentInstructions.defaultValue: Act as the trace specialist for the lab application. Correlate alerts only when they describe the same customer impact and keep unrelated infrastructure alerts separate. Always create an issue for severity 1 or severity 2 agent task or efficiency failures and add [OPS-REVIEW] to the title. Reconstruct the Application Insights request, agent, model, handoff, and tool hierarchy; report technical, task, performance, and trace health separately. Produce an SRE handoff packet with customer impact, likely fault domain and confidence, three timestamped evidence points with sources, the smallest safe correction, rollback conditions, missing evidence, and fixed-run verification criteria. Do not claim remediation or incident closure.

variables.$fxv#0:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where type == "GenAI" and name == "customer_support_agent"
| extend Scenario = tostring(customDimensions["scenario"]),
         Mode = tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"]),
         TechnicalSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["technical.success"]),
         TaskSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["task.success"]),
         PerformanceSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["performance.success"]),
         TraceComplete = tostring(customDimensions["trace.complete"])
| summarize Runs = count(),
            TechnicalFailures = countif(TechnicalSuccess == "false"),
            TaskFailures = countif(TaskSuccess == "false"),
            PerformanceFailures = countif(PerformanceSuccess == "false"),
            IncompleteTraces = countif(TraceComplete == "false"),
            P95DurationMs = percentile(duration, 95)
    by Scenario, Mode
| order by Scenario asc, Mode asc
variables.$fxv#1:
let TraceId = "<paste-operation-id>";
union
    (pageViews | project timestamp, operation_Id, itemType = "pageView", name, duration, success = true, resultCode = "", customDimensions),
    (requests | project timestamp, operation_Id, itemType = "request", name, duration, success, resultCode, customDimensions),
    (dependencies | project timestamp, operation_Id, itemType = strcat("dependency:", type), name, duration, success, resultCode, customDimensions),
    (customEvents | project timestamp, operation_Id, itemType = "event", name, duration = 0.0, success = true, resultCode = "", customDimensions)
| where operation_Id == TraceId
| extend Scenario = tostring(customDimensions["scenario"]),
         Mode = tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"]),
         Agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"]),
         Tool = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.tool.name"]),
         TaskSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["task.success"])
| project timestamp, itemType, name, duration, success, resultCode, Agent, Tool, Scenario, Mode, TaskSuccess
| order by timestamp asc
variables.$fxv#2:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where type == "GenAI" and name == "customer_support_agent"
| extend Scenario = tostring(customDimensions["scenario"]),
         Mode = tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"]),
         TaskSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["task.success"]) == "true",
         PerformanceSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["performance.success"]) == "true",
         RetryCount = toint(customDimensions["retry.count"]),
         InputTokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         OutputTokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize Runs = count(),
            TaskSuccessRate = 100.0 * countif(TaskSuccess) / count(),
            PerformanceSuccessRate = 100.0 * countif(PerformanceSuccess) / count(),
            P50DurationMs = percentile(duration, 50),
            P95DurationMs = percentile(duration, 95),
            AvgRetries = avg(RetryCount),
            AvgInputTokens = avg(InputTokens),
            AvgOutputTokens = avg(OutputTokens)
    by Scenario, Mode
| order by Scenario asc, Mode asc
variables.$fxv#3:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where type == "GenAI" and name == "customer_support_agent"
| extend Scenario = tostring(customDimensions["scenario"]),
         Mode = tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"]),
         RetryCount = toint(customDimensions["retry.count"]),
         InputTokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         OutputTokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
         TaskSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["task.success"])
| summarize Runs = count(),
            SuccessfulRuns = countif(TaskSuccess == "true"),
            Retries = sum(RetryCount),
            InputTokens = sum(InputTokens),
            OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens)
    by Scenario, Mode
| extend TokensPerSuccessfulTask = iff(SuccessfulRuns > 0, todouble(InputTokens + OutputTokens) / SuccessfulRuns, real(null))
| order by TokensPerSuccessfulTask desc nulls last
variables.$fxv#4:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where type == "GenAI" and name == "customer_support_agent"
| extend Scenario = tostring(customDimensions["scenario"]),
         Mode = tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"]),
         TraceComplete = tostring(customDimensions["trace.complete"])
| summarize Runs = count(),
            Incomplete = countif(TraceComplete == "false"),
            Complete = countif(TraceComplete == "true")
    by Scenario, Mode
| extend CompletenessRate = 100.0 * Complete / Runs
| order by CompletenessRate asc
variables.$fxv#5:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where type == "GenAI" and name == "customer_support_agent"
| extend Cohort = tostring(customDimensions["synthetic.cohort"]),
         AgentVersion = tostring(customDimensions["agent.version"]),
         WorkflowVersion = tostring(customDimensions["workflow.version"]),
         TaskSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["task.success"]),
         PerformanceSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["performance.success"])
| summarize Runs = count(),
            TaskFailureRate = 100.0 * countif(TaskSuccess == "false") / count(),
            PerformanceFailureRate = 100.0 * countif(PerformanceSuccess == "false") / count(),
            P95DurationMs = percentile(duration, 95)
    by Cohort, AgentVersion, WorkflowVersion
| order by TaskFailureRate desc, PerformanceFailureRate desc
variables.$fxv#6:
let BrowserCalls =
    dependencies
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | extend SyntheticSession = tostring(customDimensions["synthetic.session_id"])
    | where isnotempty(SyntheticSession)
    | project operation_Id, SyntheticSession, BrowserTimestamp = timestamp, BrowserCall = name;
let AgentRuns =
    dependencies
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where type == "GenAI" and name == "customer_support_agent"
    | extend Scenario = tostring(customDimensions["scenario"]),
             Mode = tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"]),
             TaskSuccess = tostring(customDimensions["task.success"])
    | project operation_Id, AgentTimestamp = timestamp, Scenario, Mode, TaskSuccess, AgentDuration = duration;
BrowserCalls
| join kind=inner AgentRuns on operation_Id
| project BrowserTimestamp, AgentTimestamp, SyntheticSession, BrowserCall, Scenario, Mode, TaskSuccess, AgentDuration, operation_Id
| order by AgentTimestamp desc
variables.$fxv#7:
let steps = datatable(Step:int, EventName:string)
[
    1, "CustomerJourneyStarted",
    2, "CatalogViewed",
    3, "ProductSelected",
    4, "CartUpdated",
    5, "CheckoutStarted",
    6, "PurchaseCompleted"
];
let observations =
    customEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where name in ("CustomerJourneyStarted", "CatalogViewed", "ProductSelected", "CartUpdated", "CheckoutStarted", "PurchaseCompleted")
    | extend User = iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId), user_Id, user_AuthenticatedId)
    | summarize Users = dcount(User), Sessions = dcount(session_Id), Events = count() by EventName = name;
steps
| join kind=leftouter observations on EventName
| project Step, EventName, Users = coalesce(Users, 0), Sessions = coalesce(Sessions, 0), Events = coalesce(Events, 0)
| order by Step asc
variables.$fxv#8:
let journey =
    union
        (pageViews
        | where timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where name startswith "Customer /"
        | project timestamp, session_Id, user_Id, user_AuthenticatedId, Event = name, ItemType = "pageView"),
        (customEvents
        | where timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where name in ("CustomerJourneyStarted", "CatalogViewed", "ProductSelected", "CartUpdated", "SupportRequested", "AgentResolutionViewed", "CheckoutStarted", "PaymentDeclined", "PurchaseCompleted")
        | project timestamp, session_Id, user_Id, user_AuthenticatedId, Event = name, ItemType = "customEvent");
journey
| extend User = iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId), user_Id, user_AuthenticatedId)
| order by session_Id asc, timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend NextSession = next(session_Id), NextEvent = next(Event), NextItemType = next(ItemType)
| where session_Id == NextSession
| summarize Transitions = count(), Users = dcount(User) by Event, ItemType, NextEvent, NextItemType
| order by Transitions desc
variables.$fxv#9:
let starts =
    customEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where name == "CustomerJourneyStarted"
    | extend Segment = tostring(customDimensions["customer.segment"]),
             Variant = tostring(customDimensions["journey.variant"]),
             User = iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId), user_Id, user_AuthenticatedId)
    | summarize StartedUsers = dcount(User), StartedSessions = dcount(session_Id) by Segment, Variant;
let purchases =
    customEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where name == "PurchaseCompleted"
    | extend Segment = tostring(customDimensions["customer.segment"]),
             Variant = tostring(customDimensions["journey.variant"]),
             User = iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId), user_Id, user_AuthenticatedId)
    | summarize ConvertedUsers = dcount(User), ConvertedSessions = dcount(session_Id) by Segment, Variant;
starts
| join kind=leftouter purchases on Segment, Variant
| extend ConvertedUsers = coalesce(ConvertedUsers, 0),
         ConvertedSessions = coalesce(ConvertedSessions, 0)
| extend UserConversionPct = round(100.0 * ConvertedUsers / StartedUsers, 1),
         SessionConversionPct = round(100.0 * ConvertedSessions / StartedSessions, 1)
| project Segment, Variant, StartedUsers, ConvertedUsers, UserConversionPct, StartedSessions, ConvertedSessions, SessionConversionPct
| order by Segment asc, Variant asc

X-Forwarded-Host (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/X-Forwarded-Host#Examples).
The matching logic is ..
- If the property is null or empty (default), all hosts(or lack of) are allowed.
- A value is compared using ordinal-ignore-case (excluding port number).
- Subdomain wildcards are permitted but don't match the root domain. For example, *.contoso.com matches the subdomain foo.contoso.com
but not the root domain contoso.com or multi-level foo.bar.contoso.com
- Unicode host names are allowed but are converted to Punycode for matching.

X-Forwarded-For (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/X-Forwarded-For#Examples).
The matching logic is ..
- If the property is null or empty (default), any forwarded-for chains (or lack of) are allowed.
- If any address (excluding port number) in the chain (comma separated) matches the CIDR defined by the property.

The matching logic is ..
- If the property is null or empty (default), all hosts(or lack of) are allowed.
- A value is compared using ordinal-ignore-case (excluding port number).
- Subdomain wildcards are permitted but don't match the root domain. For example, *.contoso.com matches the subdomain foo.contoso.com
but not the root domain contoso.com or multi-level foo.bar.contoso.com
- Unicode host names are allowed but are converted to Punycode for matching.

X-Forwarded-For (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/X-Forwarded-For#Examples).
The matching logic is ..
- If the property is null or empty (default), any forwarded-for chains (or lack of) are allowed.
- If any address (excluding port number) in the chain (comma separated) matches the CIDR defined by the property.

X-Azure-FDID and X-FD-HealthProbe.
The matching logic is exact match.

X-Forwarded-Host (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/X-Forwarded-Host#Examples).
The matching logic is ..
- If the property is null or empty (default), all hosts(or lack of) are allowed.
- A value is compared using ordinal-ignore-case (excluding port number).
- Subdomain wildcards are permitted but don't match the root domain. For example, *.contoso.com matches the subdomain foo.contoso.com
but not the root domain contoso.com or multi-level foo.bar.contoso.com
- Unicode host names are allowed but are converted to Punycode for matching.

X-Forwarded-For (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/X-Forwarded-For#Examples).
The matching logic is ..
- If the property is null or empty (default), any forwarded-for chains (or lack of) are allowed.
- If any address (excluding port number) in the chain (comma separated) matches the CIDR defined by the property.

X-Azure-FDID and X-FD-HealthProbe.
The matching logic is exact match.

variables.trafficLightsQuery:
let lookback = 15m;
let nowT = now();
let vm = Heartbeat
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
  | summarize LastBeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType
  | extend SecondsSince = datetime_diff("second", nowT, LastBeat)
  | extend Status = case(SecondsSince <= 300, "🟢", SecondsSince <= 900, "🟠", "🔴")
  | project ResourceType = strcat("VM (", OSType, ")"), Resource = Computer, Status,
            Detail = strcat("Last heartbeat ", SecondsSince, "s ago");
let aksNodes = Perf
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
  | where ObjectName == "K8SNode" and CounterName == "cpuUsageNanoCores"
  | summarize LastSample = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
  | summarize Total = count();
let aksRestarts = toscalar(KubePodInventory
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
  | summarize MaxRestarts = max(toint(ContainerRestartCount)) by Namespace, Name
  | summarize Restarts = sum(MaxRestarts)
  | project Restarts);
let aks = aksNodes
  | extend Restarts = aksRestarts
  | extend Status = case(Total == 0, "🔴", Restarts > 5, "🟠", "🟢")
  | extend Detail = strcat(Total, " nodes reporting · ", Restarts, " restarts (15m)")
  | project ResourceType = "AKS Cluster", Resource = "aks", Status, Detail;
let app = AppServiceHTTPLogs
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
  | summarize FiveXX = countif(ScStatus >= 500), Total = count() by _ResourceId
  | extend Status = case(FiveXX >= 5, "🔴", FiveXX > 0, "🟠", "🟢")
  | extend ResourceType = "App Service", Resource = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[8])
  | project ResourceType, Resource, Status, Detail = strcat(Total, " req · ", FiveXX, " 5xx (15m)");
let appi = workspace("__APPI_LAW__").AppRequests
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
  | summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(Success == false)
  | extend Status = case(Failed >= 10, "🔴", Failed > 0, "🟠", "🟢")
  | project ResourceType = "App Insights", Resource = "appi", Status,
            Detail = strcat(Total, " requests · ", Failed, " failed (15m)");
union isfuzzy=true vm, aks, app, appi
| extend SortKey = case(Status == "🔴", 0, Status == "🟠", 1, 2)
| order by SortKey asc, ResourceType asc
| project-away SortKey

properties.query:
let heartbeats = Heartbeat
  | summarize LastHB = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType
  | extend MinutesSinceHB = datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastHB);
let cpu = InsightsMetrics
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
  | where Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage"
  | summarize AvgCpu = avg(Val) by Computer;
heartbeats
| join kind=leftouter cpu on Computer
| extend AvgCpu = coalesce(AvgCpu, 0.0)
| extend Status = case(
    MinutesSinceHB > 5 or AvgCpu > 90, "Red",

content.json:
## 💰 Central LAW ingestion volume

This workbook reads only the central Log Analytics workspace `Usage` table. It does **not** include compute, App Service, Grafana, Event Hubs, ACR, disks/IPs, network monitoring, alerts, tests, other workspaces, or optional agents, and it does not reconcile the Azure bill. Use it to find candidates for **DCR transformations** and **Basic Logs**, then use [Azure Cost Management](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_CostManagement/Menu/~/costanalysis) for actual and forecast charges.
